schema.description: Request schema for rescheduling a public appointment

end_at.description: The new end time of the appointment as an ISO-8601 datetime string with a timezone offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T11:00:00-05:00` or `2025-03-01T16:00:00Z`). The `time_zone` field determines the canonical timezone.

provider_id.description: The ID of the provider to assign to the appointment. If not provided, the provider assigned to the original appointment will be used.

start_at.description: The new start time of the appointment as an ISO-8601 datetime string with a timezone offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T10:00:00-05:00` or `2025-03-01T15:00:00Z`). The `time_zone` field determines the canonical timezone.

time_zone.description: The local time zone for the appointment (IANA format).

schema.title: ReschedulePublicAppointmentRequest
